title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 5: Letters

scenes.say: Mail room. Evening. Ali opens a letter from his mom.
scenes.visual: a soldier opening an envelope in a mail room, evening light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Enclosed, a crayon drawing from his little sister.
scenes.visual: a child's crayon drawing of a house and a soldier, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We miss you. Keep your head up. Don't forget who you are.
scenes.visual: a handwritten letter on lined paper, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali stares at the drawing. A tear forms. He hides it.
scenes.visual: a soldier holding a crayon drawing, head bowed, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy leans over. That your girl?
scenes.visual: two soldiers sitting on a bench, one leaning toward the other, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Nah. That's my lil' sister. She the only one still innocent.
scenes.visual: the crayon drawing in a soldier's hands, soft light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He folds the letter and tucks it in his chest pocket.
scenes.visual: a folded letter slid into a uniform chest pocket, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a cargo plane on a runway at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Six. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a letter tucked behind dog tags on a cot, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 5 of 25: Letters. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
